routePolicy: Every context request is intercepted and fulfilled only from the frozen static artifact or an explicit local503 API fixture; every external and non-GET request is aborted. route.continue/route.fetch never used.
limitations: Isolated local browser UI and preserved-tool smoke only; production HTTPS, SSO and deployed byte integrity are separate checks.
Existing external Google Fonts requests are aborted; available local fonts/fallbacks render. No external map, tile or API provider is tested.
Financial/orientation and urban unit suites are not repeated; no financial values or personal data are entered.
No ranking, crawling, indexation, AI citation, real analytics collection or commercial delivery result is inferred.
harnessCorrection: Initial Playwright isDisabled() assertion on FIELDSET elements was replaced with explicit fieldset.disabled, disabled attribute and inherited :disabled state of each actual control; the complete final12-case matrix passed. No application files changed.

visualReview.method: All four actual Chrome screenshots opened with view_image and inspected.
findings: Entorno1440: heading, ordered three-point methodology and three context links remain legible in the two-column section.
Entorno390: methodology wraps to one column without global horizontal overflow or clipped text.
Centro1440: the new Entorno link remains within the existing orientation introduction and four route cards.
Centro390: advisory CTA, alternate Contacto link and the unchanged blank form render in one column.
visualReview.existingFixedUI: The preserved privacy launcher appears over portions of long-section captures. It was not hidden or changed; optional tracking was rejected.
limits: Visual review covers four captures at1440/390; 320px layout is checked by DOM/overflow in the matrix.
These are local routed-artifact renders with Google Fonts aborted and local/fallback fonts. No production render or provider behavior is inferred.
No form was filled/submitted and no external map opened.
